patch.value: Compact loose chunks into indexed pack storage

The measured slice uses existing compressed loose objects. Design pack compaction with stable uncompressed identities, indexed ranges, reachability-aware retention, resumable publication and authorized erasure compatibility.
Pack and loose representations retain the same logical identities; range reads and GC work across both; corruption and interrupted compaction fail safely.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Design: indexed independently compressed object frames preserve uncompressed SHA-256 identities. Compaction, GC and authorized erasure share the existing ObjectStore writer lease; durable publication precedes loose retirement. Add mixed-storage differential, crash-boundary and competing-writer regressions in non-git trackers; benchmark a public tracker copy. Item remains in progress for orchestrator verification.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Implementation: bounded independently compressed indexed packs, actual physical member ranges in InventoryEntry, typed PackRefusal remedies, SDK ObjectStore.compact and vcs compact TOON/JSON counts. GC uses the complete existing retention-root walk; authorized erasure materializes verified loose copies and retires packs before the existing permanent-denial/deletion proof. Every transition reads under ObjectStore.withWriteLock and releases last; retries retire duplicate representations. Foreign staging records remain untouched with explicit skip reasons. SDK gap: the host ExtensionCommandSdk has no binary object-pack or compressed-range-storage primitive; binary storage reuses the package-owned store lease and filesystem backend.

All functions were restored immediately after each proof. value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Public real-data validation: read-only copy of the public unbraind/pm-vcs tracker at c7790d45aab22a3a28b4d44955a592dfc06e715e, 330 tracked files and 343 native objects in a non-git project. Loose: 343 files, 1357177 compressed bytes, 2187264 allocated bytes; pack: 1 file, 1262545 compressed bytes, 1265664 allocated bytes. Warm verified-read median/p95 (301 samples): loose 0.105721/0.894680 ms; packed 0.241476/1.440179 ms. All 686 differential reads across compaction and GC matched; GC removed 0 live objects. Packed reads are slower in this measurement; no speedup claim. Aggregate receipt: docs/indexed-pack-benchmark.json. Full npm/Bun release-gate evidence will come from CI because the shared host is saturated.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Final foreign-record audit found an erasure gap: skipping a valid owned staging job as a whole when it contained a foreign child could retain the owned payload; recursive post-publication cleanup could also delete a late foreign child. Recovery/publication now remove only regular payload and owner leaves, in payload-first order, remove only empty directories, and report late foreign records with bounded skip details. New tests preserve foreign records injected at every staging cleanup boundary and prove authorized erasure removes the owned staging payload beside foreign notes. Focused tests passed 4/4 plus typecheck/test typecheck/lint. Revert proofs: restoring only the whole-job foreign skip fails the erasure regression (1/1 fails); restoring recursive cleanup fails both preservation/error regressions (2/2 fail). Expanded real SIGKILL/interleaving schedules now include each staging-leaf retirement boundary.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Orchestrator review reopened implementation work on PR 150. Close the reader class with one generation-checked resolver and pinned descriptors for logical, typed, bounded, streaming, existence and inventory APIs; enumerate the exported reader surface and cover every reader against every compact/unpack/repack/GC boundary. Use an eight-attempt bounded retry and distinguish stable absence from active transitions. Centralize filesystem durability, exercise forced capabilities and real Windows GC, skip recognized loose temporaries before decoding, and record isolated read/durability revert proofs. Preserve completed pack identity, retention and benchmark evidence; keep the item in_progress.

value.text: Follow-up validation found and fixed two class-adjacent issues before final acceptance. Existing strace one-open assertions caught eager hydration reopening present objects; read, bounded reads, streams and default state now resolve once and hydrate only stable absence. Existing byte budgets remain unchanged and traces now include positioned pread64 reads. Six bounded-I/O cases pass, including a 128 MiB leaf corpus read once with bounded retained buffers; the upload-ordering case separately passes with explicit fail-closed logical-probe evidence when denial metadata is corrupt. A portable real-filesystem Windows handle-contract regression passes. Reverting only that open mode fails 0/1 with EPERM and restoration passes 1/1. Reintroducing only eager hydration in read fails the existing shared-import one-open regression 0/1; restoration passes 1/1. Final benchmark after the one-open fix: 343 loose files / 1,357,188 compressed bytes / 2,187,264 allocated versus 1 pack / 1,262,537 compressed / 1,265,664 allocated; median/p95 ms 0.185120/0.636548 loose and 0.277932/1.413965 packed; 301 samples each, 686 verified comparisons, 0 live GC removals.
